image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a Common Iguana (Iguana iguana) perched on a blue wooden railing. The iguana is facing slightly to the right, showcasing its head, upper torso, and front limbs. The background is a blurred blue body of water. The lighting is bright and natural, highlighting the texture of the scales.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is large and triangular with a prominent dewlap (loose skin fold) hanging from the throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head shape is clearly triangular and robust. A distinct fold of skin (dewlap) is visible under the chin/jaw area, consistent with the species anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are large with round pupils and golden irises.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible eye is large, the pupil appears round/vertical slit (hard to distinguish exact shape at this resolution but consistent), and the iris has a yellowish/golden hue.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: A large circular subtympanic shield (scale) is present below the tympanum.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A very prominent, large, circular scale is clearly visible on the side of the head, directly below the ear opening (tympanum). This is a definitive diagnostic feature of Iguana iguana.
The torso visible behind the forelimbs appears thick and muscular, fitting the 'robust' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Coloration is bright green in juveniles, becoming darker green to greyish-green in adults with broad black bands on the body and tail.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The iguana displays adult coloration: a mix of greyish-green, orange/yellow on the limbs, and dark banding/shading on the body. It is not the uniform bright green of a juvenile.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Row of enlarged, spine-like scales running from the nape along the midline of the back to the tail base, forming a serrated crest.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct row of spines (dorsal crest) is visible starting from the neck and continuing down the back. They are sharp and well-defined.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is covered in small, granular scales with larger, plate-like scales on the head.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image resolution allows visualization of the texture difference: smaller, bead-like scales on the body/legs and larger, smoother plates on the snout and cheek areas.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are long and muscular with five clawed digits on each foot.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Both front limbs are visible. They are muscular. The digits are long, splayed for gripping, and clearly show five digits with claws on the visible feet.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and longer than body, used for balance and defense.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is mostly out of frame or obscured by the body angle. Only the very base might be inferred, but its full length and lateral compression cannot be verified in this crop.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species classification (Iguana iguana) against look-alikes like Green Basilisks or other lizards, leveraging the high-quality visual features.
To assess the photorealism of the scales and lighting, ensuring the high detail isn't a result of over-sharpening artifacts common in AI generation.
To verify that the complex overlapping of the dewlap, spikes, and toes against the background and body does not show fusion or bleeding artifacts.

focus_areas: Digit count and separation (no fused toes)
Edge definition between iguana and blue background
